articles.headline: OpenAI agent security lapse exposed 53 user images
articles.summary: A reported security failure involving OpenAI agents leaked 53 user images, underscoring the operational and compliance risks businesses face when deploying AI agents. For companies using AI in customer support, workflow automation, or internal data handling, this raises urgency around access controls, logging, and vendor risk management.

articles.headline: Microsoft unveils Copilot super app targeting business users with AI agents
articles.summary: Microsoft’s new Copilot super app is aimed at business users who want a single interface for chat, coding, and agentic workflows. The release matters for enterprises and SMEs because it could change productivity software spending, workflow automation, and employee adoption of AI tools.

articles.headline: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
articles.summary: Anthropic’s multibillion-dollar cloud agreement signals how expensive frontier AI infrastructure can be and how hyperscale computing demand is shaping vendor revenues. Businesses watching AI adoption should note that model access, latency, and inference costs may increasingly depend on long-term infrastructure commitments.
